description:
Chaptr is a short drama app. Cinematic, Series in vertical episodes built for your phone — and a cast you can actually talk to.

Watch a chapter in ninety seconds. Romance, revenge, werewolves, mafia heirs, magic academies, enemies who turn into something else. Every episode ends somewhere you didn't want it to end. That's the point.

Then open the chat. The characters remember you — what you said, what you chose, how you treated them. The story doesn't stop when the episode does.

WHAT YOU GET
- Short vertical drama episodes, made for mobile
- Original series across romance, fantasy, mafia, campus and revenge
- Character chat with a cast that remembers your conversations
- Anime, manhwa and painterly animated worlds alongside cinematic
  live-action-style series
- New episodes and new series added every week
- Binge a full arc in one sitting, or one chapter at a time

Made for people who grew up on webtoons, BookTok, fanfic and character roleplay and want the story to look like a film.

CHAPTR PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Chaptr Premium unlocks unlimited episode viewing and unlimited character chat. Available as an auto-renewable subscription in three lengths:
• 1 Week — $9.99
• 1 Month — $24.99
• 1 Year — $99.99

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms of Service: https://chaptr.film/legal-pages/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://chaptr.film/legal-pages/privacy-policy
